profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ PayPal | Java | REST Services | JLPT N3, Studying for JLPT N2
profile.summary:
With a firm grasp of Java and the Spring Framework, my career at PayPal has been marked by a commitment to developing advanced RESTful web services and fostering a quality-driven environment through rigorous test-driven development. Our team's dedication to Agile principles has enabled us to deliver scalable software solutions that drive PayPal's platform forward.

My expertise extends to creating comprehensive test cases using frameworks like TestNG, JUnit, and RESTAssured, ensuring high code quality and system robustness. At PayPal, we collaborate to refine our practices and tools, utilizing platforms such as GitHub and Splunk to maintain a cutting-edge development workflow that consistently meets the evolving needs of our global customers.

positions.title: Software Engineer 3
positions.description:
Assisting with development of RESTful Web Services with using Spring Framework in Java
Creating Applications using the Spring Framework, along with CRUD applications via Hibernate.
Creating Unit, Integration and functional test cases for those services with using TestNG, JUnit and the RESTAssured framework.
Utilized frameworks for unit testing such as Mockito.
Experiment with using Splunk in doing queries for Production bugs and issues.
Creating Batch Jobs by using Spring Batch Framework.
Worked in a Scrum Agile development environment.
Completed bug fixes.
Performed clean up and maintenance tasks such as improving unit test code coverage and refactoring.
Utilized Github for source control. 
Engaged in TDD with writing functional tests using RESTAssured framework for features.
Assisted with doing quality assurance of other developers' features.
Performed code reviews for developers' Java code.

positions.title: Software Customer Support Analyst
positions.description: Supported hotel customers with MICROS's Opera PMS system. Troubleshooted problems with the Opera PMS such as hardware and software failures, Oracle DBMS issues and general networking problems. Assisted customers over the phone with procedural questions and how to's.

positions.title: Personal Computer Support Techninan
positions.description:
My job responbilities consisted of:
*Reinstalling and troubleshooting operating systems on PCs 
*Adding and removing PC hardware components 
*Removing of malicious software on customer PCs
*Helping customers with procedural questions

volunteerExperiences.description: Engaged in Japanese conversations with people in able to help with their conversation skills as part of the Japanese Language club at Anne Arundel Community College.

Posted educational videos about computing on Piazza that related to course material (Computer Architecture) and/or fascinating that I had found while studying. 
Implemented test cases for class projects such as MeeshQuest in able to help fellow classmates to test their source code for correctness.

projects.title: Japanese Verb Conjugator V2
projects.description: Migration from using core Java to incorporate using Maven and the Spring framework. Also incorporate more functionality such as allowing romaji and dictionary.

projects.title: Japanese Verb Conjugator
projects.description: A Java program that I'm currently working that is used in able to help people to conjugate Japanese verbs. A person would enter in the word in Japanese, then it's conjugated form shows up in the GUI.
